user.title: Morning Routine
user.description: Set up your morning routine. Steps can be edited later in Configure.

abort.already_configured: Morning Routine is already set up.

data.name: Name
data.image: Picture (pick bundled / from /config/www/morning/, or paste any URL)

data_description.tts_text: Empty = the default text from Settings. Placeholders: {name}, {minutes}, {start}, {end}, {next}. Text with {{ … }} or {% … %} is a Home Assistant template.
data_description.tts_prewarn_text: Empty = the default pre-warn text from Settings. Also {in_minutes} and {in_seconds}.
data_description.tts_prewarn_seconds: Empty = the time from Settings, 0 = nothing before this step.

data.name: Name
data.image: Picture (pick bundled / from /config/www/morning/, or paste any URL)

data_description.tts_text: Empty = the default text from Settings. Placeholders: {name}, {minutes}, {start}, {end}, {next}. Text with {{ … }} or {% … %} is a Home Assistant template.
data_description.tts_prewarn_text: Empty = the default pre-warn text from Settings. Also {in_minutes} and {in_seconds}.
data_description.tts_prewarn_seconds: Empty = the time from Settings, 0 = nothing before this step.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Set one holiday period by hand, and/or point at an entity that is `on` while it's a day off. Each step decides for itself what happens during holidays (see the step form).

data_description.holiday_from: Leave both dates empty if there is no holiday period. A single date on its own counts as that one day.
data_description.holiday_to: Last day of the holiday — included.
data_description.holiday_entity: Any entity that is 'on' during a day off — input_boolean, binary_sensor, schedule or a calendar.

data.tts_service: TTS service (only without a TTS engine)

data_description.tts_engine: Speaks through tts.speak, e.g. tts.piper. Empty = the TTS service below.
data_description.tts_voice: Optional, depends on the engine (e.g. marylux).
data_description.tts_default_text: For steps without their own text. Empty = "Elo: {name}". Placeholders: {name}, {minutes}, {start}, {end}, {next}. Text with {{ … }} or {% … %} is a Home Assistant template.

abort.no_steps: No steps configured yet — add one first.

error.invalid_holiday_dates: That date could not be read. Pick the dates with the calendar, or clear both fields.
